data.long_meaning: Mohan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mohana’, which means 'to attract'. It refers to a person who has the power to captivate the minds of others. The name मोहन carries the meaning “Attractor of Minds” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi.
